tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List all available countries with relocation information.

tools.name: get_country_guide
tools.description: Get a relocation guide by country name, alias, or ISO2; lang must be a supported language.

tools.name: get_customs_rules
tools.description: Get customs/import rules by country name, alias, or ISO2; lang must be a supported language.

tools.name: find_local_help
tools.description: Find registered local relocation partners by country, optionally filtered by partner type.

tools.name: estimate_moving_volume
tools.description: Estimate moving volume in m3 from one room preset or catalog item list.

tools.name: get_country_facts
tools.description: Get residence permits, taxes, or cost-of-living facts for a country when published.

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compare one published content topic side by side for two to four countries.

tools.name: search_countries
tools.description: Search country names and relocation summaries with accent-insensitive token/stem matching.

tools.name: get_movers
tools.description: Get moving companies for one unambiguous country name, alias, or ISO2 code.

tools.name: request_moving_quote
tools.description: Submit a moving quote request to relocation123.com.

tools.name: get_immigration_help
tools.description: Get verified immigration providers for a covered country name, alias, or ISO2 code.
